prompt: Can I carry over unused vacation days into next year?

reply.message: Yes, up to 5 unused PTO days can carry over into the next year. Any unused days beyond 5 expire on December 31. Full-time employees accrue 20 days per year (1.67 per month). Interns accrue 1 day per month, and contractors don't accrue PTO. Also, absences of 3 or more consecutive working days need 2 weeks' notice, and PTO is booked in the HR portal.

prompt: Can I work from home a few days a week?

reply.message: Yes. Under POL-REM-01, office-based employees may work remotely up to 2 days a week, as long as the arrangement is agreed with your manager. Fully remote work needs VP approval. Working from another country is allowed for up to 20 working days per calendar year and needs HR approval at least 2 weeks in advance.

prompt: Is there a home office stipend?

prompt: Can I carry over unused vacation days into next year?

reply.message: Yes, partly. Under POL-PTO-01, full-time employees accrue 20 PTO days per year. Up to 5 unused days carry over into the next year; any remaining unused days expire on December 31. Interns accrue 1 day per month, and contractors don't accrue PTO. PTO is booked in the HR portal, and absences of 3 or more consecutive working days need 2 weeks' notice.
